blurb: This check confirms whether quorum is enabled on a fully-mirrored rootvg. On a 2-disk mirror, QUORUM=2 can keep the surviving disk from varying on at boot after a disk failure, so most shops disable it (chvg -Qn rootvg). Reports PASS when quorum is disabled, WARN when it is enabled, and NOT_APPLICABLE when rootvg is not a full mirror.
